summary: ruviform-audio-plugin-bridge::input::InputTx is pub(crate): the production MIDI feed pump (InputTx::pump -> InputStage::collect_block) cannot be driven from ruviform-audio-test. Public surface is MidiInputEnumerator -> MidiInputPort::open -> InputStage::read/pump/collect_block only.

Mirror the production InputTx::pump algorithm in a public test-owned InputPump inside the pipeline midi leg, while still driving the public InputStage API (collect_block, ClockAnchor, map_stamp_to_frame). Keeps product crates unchanged; the mirrored algorithm is asserted line-by-line against production source.

Input leg: scripted Device::open_input_stream callback PCM+InputCallbackInfo is captured into a preallocated bounded SPSC InputCapture handoff (pool_blocks x channels x capacity_frames), then each captured block is fed exactly once through production RtRuntime input_writer -> process -> output_reader. Chosen over render.rs InputFeeder because the typed runtime boundary is the documented device-input-tap equivalent and keeps capture metadata verbatim.

Session::open installs a no-op error callback: DeviceError values fired inside the production output callback are not observable through the session surface. Only PumpReport counts and invalidated state survive; recorded as an honest limit rather than worked around.

mise run fmt-check / check / lint / test ruviform-audio-test and mise run test-rt all pass on Windows; 33 pipeline tests + 9 rt_contract tests green including rt_pipeline_{output,input,midi}_*_does_not_alloc.

Pipeline wiring slice complete: output via Session::open+GraphPlan, input via open_input_stream+typed RtRuntime boundary, MIDI via InputStage with mirrored InputTx::pump. Product crates untouched; deterministic-backend evidence is OS-L1 only.
